findings.reasoning: This wires ledger chain-retirement machinery (execute_retirement, audit_retirement) into the CLI. C-008 permits retirement only under a strict, fully-enumerated procedure: explicit human-initiated decision recorded in the anchor entry, a pre-verified archive copy, a correctly-populated anchor entry, and indefinite archive retention. The diff only shows the import; it gives no visibility into ledger/retire.py's actual implementation or into how the CLI command invokes execute_retirement (e.g., whether it requires an interactive human confirmation, whether it calls audit_retirement/verify_chain on the archive before moving the original, and whether the anchor entry it writes includes all required fields). Without that implementation in context, compliance with C-008(a)-(d) cannot be confirmed from this diff alone and should be checked before this lands.

C-007 scopes the governance pipeline itself as 'challenger, defender, oracle, ledger, constitution.' cli/commands.py is not itself in that enumerated list per CLAUDE.md's rule 16, but by importing and presumably exposing ledger retirement execution, it becomes a trigger point for a highly sensitive ledger operation. This isn't a violation on its face, but the underlying ledger/retire.py module (not shown in this diff) is squarely within C-007/C-008 scope and should receive full scrutiny when it is proposed.
